'''T5-BD''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] posted at the [[Kri-Ta Outpost]] on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. There it requested the assistance of a Republic individual to lend help to the [[Voss commandos|Voss commando]] [[Abdan-Sho]].<ref name="TOR" />
